faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Velar P250 use?
faqLeft.a: The Velar P250 uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine. It has been fitted to the L560-generation Velar since the model's launch in 2017.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Velar P250 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Velar P250?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine code and specification before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ingenium AJ200P Velar P250 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every Velar P250 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Velar P250 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Velar P250 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Velar P250 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Velar P250 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
